powerAnalysis.formula: Project Wilson-Hilferty one-sided 95% chi-square sigma bound plus two-sided Gaussian tail and a 24-event union bound.

designEscalation.reason: The k=14 point estimate clears but 32 samples do not resolve the 95%-confidence circuit bound. A 164-sample k=14 run exceeds the execution window. k=16 is already a supported Boolean-scale value and widens only the Boolean decode/test-polynomial spacing; 40 samples are selected prospectively for margin above the calculated 33-sample threshold.
designEscalation.antiSelectionPolicy: This is a declared parameter/design change, not a rerun of k=14 or selection among repeated outcomes. Preserve failure if the k=16 run does not clear.

failurePolicy: Preserve an inconclusive or failing run. Do not weaken the gate or rerun to select a favorable sample.
claimBoundary: If accepted, this is an exhaustive 8-row full-adder result and a 95%-confidence Gaussian residual union bound over this circuit's 24 post-blind-rotate events at N=n=1024, covering-b2, BK sigma 128, Boolean stride k=16. It is not a k=14 result; not an arbitrary-netlist/depth, fresh-input-noise, hard deterministic BK bound, or total-GPU-memory claim.
